about:
Power Brace Manufacturing operates from Des Moines, Iowa, where it was founded in 2002. The company has built its reputation on a self-described "whatever it takes" work ethic, positioning itself as a manufacturer that defines industry standards rather than merely meeting them.

The shop delivers end-to-end steel component manufacturing, combining CNC machining, fiber laser tube and table cutting, multi-cell robotic welding, press brake forming, HD beveling plasma cutting, zinc electroplating to ASTM B633, and kitting and assembly. Equipment includes a 6-axis 3,000-watt fiber laser tube cutter, 4,000-watt fiber lasers for plate up to one inch thick, six welding robots with 12-by-3-foot work zones, 70- to 250-ton press brakes, and an automated electroplating line with tanks accommodating parts up to 12 by 5 by 17 feet. The company emphasizes lean processes for high-volume production at competitive prices.

Power Brace serves telecommunications, construction, transportation, defense, and agricultural sectors across North America. Its customer base ranges from Fortune 500 firms to small manufacturers, with named partners including Verizon, AT&T, and Google.

The company traces its formula for success to a commitment to defect-free products delivered on time through continuous improvement, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification for both manufacturing and distribution.
